description:
The Bhagavad Gita, for your life. Free forever, with no ads, no subscriptions and no sign-up.

Not to memorise, but to live by. Gita turns all 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gita into short daily lessons you can understand and use: at work, in relationships, in grief, in anger, and in the quiet search for purpose.

ONE SMALL LESSON A DAY
• 140 lessons through all 18 chapters, about 5 minutes each
• Every verse explained "in simple words", with the original Sanskrit one tap away
• Each lesson ends with a real-life scenario: what would the Gita suggest?
• A gentle reflection for your private journal, and one small practice to try today

START WHERE YOU ARE
• Tell us what brings you here: peace of mind, purpose, work, relationships, grief, focus, devotion
• Get a personal path with a guiding chapter
• Begin with 7 Essentials: the most loved teachings, from "do your work, let go of the results" to "do not grieve"
• Take a sankalpa, light your lamp, and keep your streak glowing

THE COMPLETE GITA
• All 18 chapters and 700 verses in Sanskrit (Devanagari) and transliteration
• Two English translations (Swami Sivananda and Shri Purohit Swami) and Hindi (Swami Tejomayananda)
• Word-by-word meanings for every verse
• Listen to any verse read aloud
• Search any word, or jump straight to a verse like 2.47

GITA FOR LIFE
16 life topics bring the right verses to the moment you need them: anger and desire, fear and courage, success and failure, grief and loss, focus and discipline, leading others, and more.

FREE FOR GENERATIONS
Every verse, every lesson, every feature is free, and will stay that way. No ads. No subscriptions. No paywalls.

YOURS, PRIVATELY
No account and no login: just open the app and begin. Save verses, keep the key ideas that move you, and write reflections. Your progress stays only on your device, nothing is tracked, and it works offline.

Light and dark modes, adjustable text size, and a calm design made for reading.

A Sahadeva companion.
promotionalText: All 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gita as 5-minute daily lessons. Free forever, no ads, no sign-up.
